title: options portfolio artifact
description: Read-only snapshot of the user's positions across accounts. totals = what the portfolio is WORTH (every account, cash included, a pool counted at the operator's own share); exposure = what a price drop REACHES (net crypto per asset across accounts; stablecoins and offsetting long/short pairs contribute zero). coverage_cli --portfolio consumes this; a dashboard shows both numbers and why they differ. A PUBLIC POOL account's own `usd_total` stays the venue's full pool equity — `owned_fraction` is the share that is the owner's, and `totals` applies it, so pooled depositor capital is never claimed as his worth.

read_only.description: Always true. Reading balances is not trading.

stale_after_hours.description: The artifact's own freshness rule — a dashboard shows STALE past this age.

complete.description: False when any readable account failed. Totals and exposure then UNDERSTATE reality, and coverage_cli refuses the artifact rather than price an understated position.

read.description: False for a venue with nothing to read yet (a placeholder, not an account).

usd_total_source.description: Where the account total came from. `venue` = the venue's own total_asset_value; `venue+holdings` = that PLUS the non-stable assets the venue's total leaves out (measured: total_asset_value = stablecoin balance + perp unrealized PnL, so ETH/LIT holdings and the staking pool's 113.5M LIT are not in it); `computed` = our own sum, no venue figure available.

venue_total_usd.description: The venue's own published total, kept alongside `usd_total` so the two can never be confused. It covers the stablecoin balance and perp PnL only.

role.description: pool = a Lighter public pool: an account holding other people's capital as well as the operator's.

owned_fraction.description: The share of this account that is the owner's own capital. 1.0 for every account except a pool, where it is operator_shares / total_shares. totals and exposure apply it.

pool.description: Present on a public pool. `operator_share_pct` is the ownership fraction the totals use; the rest is depositors'.

kind.description: cash = stablecoin; spot = L1 holding; balance = venue asset balance; staked = LIT committed to the venue's staking pool (custody the pool holds, so it appears in no balance); perp = signed position (the only kind that nets).

crypto_usd.description: GROSS crypto position value (both legs of an offsetting pair included) — deliberately different from exposure.usd. Scaled to the owner's share of any pool.

usd_total_gross.description: Present only when the book includes other people's capital. Sum of every account's own `usd_total` — what the accounts hold, before the pool share is applied. Compare with `usd_total` (the owner's) to see what is delegated to him.

delegated_usd.description: Present only when nonzero: the part of `usd_total_gross` that belongs to depositors in pools the owner operates. It is real capital under his management, and it is NOT his worth.

usd.description: Sum of POSITIVE net crypto across assets — the number a planner insures.
